data.question: Write a program that reads A and B and prints "Square root of A is equal to B" when A ** 0.5 equals B, otherwise "Square root of A is not equal to B".

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads A and B and prints "Square root of A is equal to B" when A ** 0.5 equals B, otherwise "Square root of A is not equal to B".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It compares A ** 0.5 with B using ==, so B must be exactly the float value produced by the power operator.
